criticalGaps: Integrate the exact-witness UTF-16 byte comparison and unique, unchanged APPID 0x12 source-name binding into the production profile with an appropriately source-bound read context; the research probe alone cannot qualify output.

Integrate and independently review source-bound dictionary/XRECORD/SCALE observer and end-to-end refusal/retry controls in the production profile; standalone research spans alone do not authorize output.

Prove the other 31 complete SCALE member frames, entire NOD source wire as needed, immutable typed/class-row provenance, same-import-session/projection evidence and output remapping; typed member identities and independently observed dictionary links are not full graph closure.
Unknown body, string or handle tails must remain refused, with malformed/truncated EED, wrong APPID/roles/targets, destination preservation and same-adapter retry controls.
reuseAssessment.currentResult: Standalone probes match six dictionary frames, primary and nested XRECORDs and SCALE 0x127 to live typed capture and pinned independent LibreDWG trace/JSON. The selected NOD edge and all 32 typed SCALE identities are corroborated, but the full NOD wire and 31 SCALE record bodies remain open. Production output, immutable baseline rechecks, end-to-end export rollback/retry and native consumer semantics are not established. No guard or support claim is changed.

limitations: Trace and raw-frame observer describe this one exact physical witness; they do not establish broad producer or version support.
The previous multi-root projected-output result is historical and does not pass on the current head.
This is a test-only projected profile, not whole-source or native consumer semantics.
No external drawing fixture was committed.

Production integration requires a genuine same-import-session LAYER_CONTROL proof and preservation of the matching APPID source snapshot in any test-only projection; existing projected tests may lack those and must not synthesize provenance.

boundedEedProbe.result: PASS: source and peer trace SHA-256 guard, independently decoded APPID 0x12 name ACAD and EED fields, matching live typed EED values, APPID role/handle/name and source-name snapshot, token spans and UTF-16 text bytes. Wrong handle role, wrong APPID, changed text, unknown code, and truncated EED are rejected; corrected retry succeeds. Hash guard rejects incorrect source and trace.
boundedEedProbe.limits: Source-specific EED byte and APPID-name evidence. This is not end-to-end export refusal/retry, native consumer testing, production integration, or a profile admission. The live typed dictionary was matched; its captured typed baseline was checked for presence but not independently compared.

boundedDictionaryProbe.build: The runner builds libdxfrw_test_adapter, then compiles a scratch executable with -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror and links it to the built adapter and libdxfrw.
boundedDictionaryProbe.result: PASS: captured raw bodies, detached UTF-16 names, string presence/size footer and ordered handle streams agree with the typed unique dictionaries and the independently decoded LibreDWG 0.14 trace. Six source frames are tested; this is a standalone research observer and does not relax any output guard.
boundedDictionaryProbe.negativeControls: 128 dictionary mutations covering body, string byte, footer, owner/reactor/item role and target, inserted extra body bit, truncated handle stream and extra handle byte are rejected; original-byte retries succeed for all but the appended-byte case. The extra-body-bit mutation changes the declared body endpoint and is rejected by the fixed-profile endpoint check; it does not independently prove that an otherwise accepted length cannot hide a body gap. Separately, existing EED role/target/text/code/truncation controls pass. These are research-observer controls, not file-export destination or adapter retry tests.
